sensitivity_context.purpose: Post-acquisition sensitivity check, NOT a re-registration of N. The frozen pre-registered sample size remains |D|=60 (data/experiments/power_analysis_wilcoxon.json). This artifact answers: what power does the same design realize at the empirically available N=48?
sensitivity_context.trigger: Phase 2 demand acquisition (docs/phase2-demand-acquisition-audit.md) closed at N=48 real, verified, deduplicated Spain-origin demands after exhausting reproducible public sources under the frozen eligibility criterion. N=60 was not reachable without relaxing eligibility, fabricating/imputing observations, or mixing incompatible demand constructs.
